regions.name: Lagoa dos Patos
regions.quote: Following Lucinda (2008) its natural range comprises the Lagoa dos Patos system, lower rio Uruguai, rio Tramandaí, and rio Mampituba in Rio Grande do Sul state, Brazil, plus coastal systems of Uruguay and Argentina.
